assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE perfectly regular square 3 by 3 atlas of nine standalone square original scenes with wide cream gutters centered at exact thirds. All in first-grade illustrated-book style, quiet cut-paper gouache, fine paper grain, warm cream, deep pine, apricot, with persimmon accents. No writing, text, letters, numerals, logos, equations, hand-lettered signs, labels, or watermarks. Each image has one easy-to-recognize meaning. Top row from left: (1) a little girl in orange replaces a loose paper flag by clipping it to a string with a clearly visible wooden clothespin, calm indoor table; (2) a large collection of many finished small paper lanterns spread in neat rows on a preparation table, no people; (3) friendly caregiver raises an open palm in a clear stop gesture to a child about to step across a low soft cord marking off an area, child's hands relaxed, safe setting with no dangerous objects. Middle row: (4) little paper flower decorations spread across several separate corners of a spacious classroom including wall and tables, showing many places, no print; (5) child looks around multiple separate corners of a garden for a missing mitten, small visible empty bench and two different shrubs, no illustrations inside the cell; (6) clean cross-path in a small garden seen at a slight overhead angle, left trail to a single green arched doorway, right trail to a blue bench, no arrow or sign, lots of uncluttered ground in the lower half. Bottom row: (7) an inviting small pine-green community exhibit booth with apricot flags and one orange hanging lantern, side walls and doorway clearly marking one identifiable place, no people; (8) an East Asian adult in dark green and young girl in a cream-collared orange coat reading together at home, relaxed child points to an open cream book as the adult smiles, no writing on pages, not the same angle as the atlas reference; (9) adult and girl preparing for a winter family gathering by arranging blank peach cards and a simple paper window decoration on the table, no text. Keep character faces and hands inside the cell, no collage within cells.
